Recomended topics to add to the repository (copy these in the repository Settings → Topics):

- linux
- infrastructure
- devops
- ansible
- bash
- docker
- security
- sre
- automation

How to add topics:
1. Go to your repository page on GitHub.
2. Click on the gear icon near the repository name (or the 'Manage topics' link).
3. Add the topics above and press Enter.

Notes: adding topics helps discoverability on GitHub. You can also add a short description on the repository header if desired.
